model: The foundation model and any fine-tunes that make up the system — the classic SBOM captures software dependencies but not models.
datasets: The datasets, corpus snapshots and prompt templates the system is built on, with their licences and provenance.
dependencies: The third-party libraries and packages the system links, whose provenance supply-chain risk turns on.
build: The build pipeline, instrumented to produce its own proof: it captures the composition of the system as it is assembled.
aibom: The AI bill of materials emitted at build in a standard format — labelled CycloneDX ML-BOM or the SPDX 3.0 AI profile — covering models, datasets, prompts, dependencies and their provenance and licences.
registry: The registry entry the AIBOM is attached to; regenerating it on each build keeps it from drifting from the deployed system.
vuln: Vulnerability matching and supply-chain risk assessment, answered as a query over the AIBOM rather than reconstructed by hand.
docs: Regulator-facing transparency and GPAI documentation, generated from the AIBOM to answer which model, from which provenance, trained on which data, is inside the system.
